# Confluence-jjs 5.0.194

This release focuses on stability and internal cleanup.

The Home music display and Song Popup runtime have been substantially simplified. Unnecessary background activity, repeated refreshes and redundant geometry updates were removed or reduced, so artwork and playback controls remain stable when navigating through Kodi and during normal library activity.

The release also includes several smaller stability corrections found while cleaning up the runtime code.

## Installation

Download `skin.confluence.custom-5.0.194.zip` from the release assets and install it in Kodi via **Add-ons -> Install from zip file**.

This version was device-tested before publication.
